title: Record the FFT invoice time constants
body:
## Summary
- For every width from 3 through `2^20`, the FFT geometry satisfies `r beta < 8n`, `ell+1 <= 2 beta` and `p0 <= 4 beta`.
- The three setup terms are then at most `256`, `512` and `64` times `n beta^2`, and those three products of the stated factors are exact.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
